page.content:
After Sun Wukong accidentally shot beams of light up into Heaven, the Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Li Eyes and Wind-Following Ears down to find out what happened. They reported Son Wukong's existence back to him.

page.overview:
Who is Thousand-Li Eyes?

After Sun Wukong accidentally shot beams of light up into Heaven, the Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Li Eyes and Wind-Following Ears down to find out what happened. They reported Son Wukong's existence back to him.
